conditions.summary: Development commencement deadline
conditions.text: The development permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of 30.05.2025.

conditions.summary: Approved plans and documents
conditions.text: The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following drawings and documents: Location Plan , A100 Rev P2 Pre-existing Proposed Plans, A101 Rev P2 Pre-existing Proposed Elevations and Sections, Planning Statement by Henry Planning (November 2025), Energy Statement by ATSPACE (October 2025), Landscape Plan OS_AJM001 Rev C, Landscape Planting Plan OS_AJM003 Rev C, Ground Investigation Report by GW Groundwater (November 2024), Drainage Strategy by John Davies Associates (November 2024).

conditions.summary: External materials to match existing building
conditions.text: All external materials to be used in the development shall match the appearance of those of the existing building, unless otherwise stated in the submitted application form or approved drawings.

conditions.summary: Cycle storage provision
conditions.text: Prior to occupation of the dwelling hereby approved, cycle storage shall be provided within the curtilage of the development, within secure, lockable compounds in accordance with the designated locations identified in the approved drawings listed under condition 2 and all adopted standards prior to the first occupation of the building. The storage spaces shall be permanently retained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Refuse and recycling storage
conditions.text: The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until refuse and recycling storage within a secure enclosure has been provided in accordance with the designated location identified in the approved drawings listed under condition 2 and in accordance with the Local Planning Authority Standards and has been fully implemented and made available for use. These facilities shall permanently retained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Hard and soft landscaping works
conditions.text: Prior to first occupation of the development, hard and soft landscaping works, including trees shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details on the submitted Landscaping Plan and Planting Scheme. Any trees or other plants, which die or are removed within the first five years following the implementation of the landscaping scheme, shall be replaced during the next planting season, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Drainage Strategy compliance
conditions.text: The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Drainage Strategy by John Davies Associates (November 2024 (Revision D) referenced in Condition 2 and maintained as such thereafter.

conditions.summary: Energy measures - Solar PV and battery storage installation
conditions.text: The measures identified in the Energy Statement by ATSPACE (October 2025) shall be implemented including the installation of Solar PV (total of 18kW with 2x8kW Battery Storage) and maintained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Solar PV equipment permitted development compliance
conditions.text: Any solar PV or solar thermal equipment installed on the roof of the subject dwellinghouse must adhere to the of provisions, limitation and conditions of Schedule 2, Part 14, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015.

conditions.summary: No extensions without planning permission
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 or any Order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification, no extension, enlargement or other alteration of the new dwellinghouse other than that expressly authorised by this permission shall be carried out without planning permission first obtained from the local planning authority.

conditions.summary: Noise assessment and building envelope sound insulation
conditions.text: A noise assessment report shall be submitted to the Council for approval in writing, of external noise sources including transport/ industrial/ commercial/ cultural uses and their noise levels occurring at the site during most of the year, i.e. measured during school and work weekdays, in accordance with internal noise limits specified in BS8233:2014, including the aircraft noise data in Section 6, SPG10 (worst mode aircraft 1-day noise contour (60 dB). Details shall include the sound insulation of the building envelope including glazing specifications (laboratory tested including frames, seals and any integral ventilators, approved in accordance with BS EN ISO 10140-2:2010) and of acoustically attenuated mechanical ventilation and cooling as necessary (with air intake from the cleanest aspect of the building and details of self-noise) Best practicable mitigation measures shall also be implemented, as necessary, in external amenity spaces to achieve criteria of BS8233:2014. The approved details shall be implemented prior to occupation of the development and thereafter be permanently retained.

conditions.summary: Plant noise limit (BS4142)
conditions.text: The rating noise level (LAr,Tr) of the individual and combined maximum noise emitted by plant, ducting and equipment at the development site shall be lower than the lowest existing background sound level by at least 10dBA, as measured at/ calculated to the nearest and most affected noise sensitive premises at the development site and at surrounding premises. The assessment shall be made in accordance with BS4142:2014 +A1 2019, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

conditions.summary: Anti-vibration isolators for plant and equipment
conditions.text: Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment/ extraction/ ventilation system and ducting at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such.

conditions.summary: Rooflight protrusion limit

conditions.text: The wording of condition 10 of planning permission ref: 242362FUL dated 06.11.2025 can hereby be taken to be: Prior to occupation of development on the site, a Site and Operations Management Plan shall be submitted to the Council for approval in writing, confirming proposed: - hours of use of the site, - times and frequency of deliveries, collections, activities and vehicle movements, - location of loading bays/ service areas, - a clear policy of considerate behaviour and careful handling, avoiding intermittent - noise such as banging, clanging, dropping heavy items, rattling cages, etc. - quiet reversing methods and vehicle movements, - quiet tail lift operations and transfer/ movement of goods, - absorbent surfaces, - the monitoring procedure for noise emissions during delivery operations, - effective response to complaints, - commitment to implement mitigation measures as necessary. conditions.summary: Contaminated land investigation and remediation
conditions.text: In the event contamination is found at any time when carrying out the approved development, it must be reported in writing immediately to the Local Planning Authority. An investigation and risk assessment must be undertaken in accordance with details to be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority. Where remediation is necessary, a remediation scheme must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Following completion of measures identified in the approved remediation scheme a verification report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Hard landscaping scheme details
conditions.text: No development above ground level shall take place until details of a hard landscaping scheme for the site have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall include proposed finished levels and contours showing any earthworks and/or mounding; surfacing materials; boundary treatments and means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access, circulation / turning areas; hard surfacing materials; minor artefacts and structures (for example outdoor seating areas, cycle storage, refuse/recycling, storage units, and similar features, etc); proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (for example drainage, power, communications cables and pipelines, indicating lines, manholes, supports and other technical features); retained historic landscape features and proposals for restoration where relevant. The scheme shall be implemented prior to the first use of any part of the proposed development.

conditions.summary: Landscape management plan
conditions.text: No development above ground level shall take place until a landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules and periods for all soft landscape areas together with a timetable for the implementation of the landscape management plan, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The landscape management plan shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and timetable.

conditions.summary: Arboricultural Method Statement and tree protection
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of development (including any demolition, groundworks and site clearance) in any given phase, an Arboricultural Method Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority relating to that phase. The Statement(s) should include details of the following: a) Tree Protection Plan and measures for the protection of those trees and hedges on the application site that are to be retained; b) Details of all construction measures within the 'Root Protection Area' (defined by a radius of dbh x 12 where dbh is the diameter of the trunk measured at a height of 1.5m above ground level) of those trees on the application site which are to be retained specifying the position, depth, and method of construction/installation/excavation of service trenches, building foundations, hardstandings, roads and footpaths; c) A schedule of proposed surgery works to be undertaken to those trees and hedges on the application site which are to be retained. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Method Statement(s) unless agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Compliance with Flood Risk Assessment

P23-2673 and Report titled "Response to Hertfordshire County Council Lead Local Flood Authority (LLFA) comments, by Pegasus group, dated 24 October 2025, reference: P23-2673_N003v3).

conditions.summary: External materials samples approval

conditions.summary: Construction Management Plan
conditions.text: No development shall commence until a Construction Management Plan (or Construction Method Statement) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter the construction of the development shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Plan. The Construction Management Plan/Statement shall include details of: a. Construction vehicle numbers, type, routing; b. Access arrangements to the site; c. Traffic management requirements; d. Construction and storage compounds (including areas designated for car parking, loading / unloading and turning areas); e. Siting and details of wheel washing facilities; f. Cleaning of site entrances, site tracks and the adjacent public highway; g. Timing of construction activities (including delivery times and removal of waste) and to avoid school pick up/drop off times; h. Provision of sufficient on-site parking prior to commencement of construction activities; i. Post construction restoration/reinstatement of the working areas and temporary access to the public highway; j. where works cannot be contained wholly within the site a plan should be submitted showing the site layout on the highway including extent of hoarding, pedestrian routes and remaining road width for vehicle movements; k. Phasing Plan.

conditions.summary: Invasive Species Management Plan
conditions.text: NO DEVELOPMENT SHALL TAKE PLACE UNTIL an Invasive Species Management Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in compliance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Habitat Management and Monitoring Plan
conditions.text: NO DEVELOPMENT SHALL TAKE PLACE UNTIL an Habitat Management and Monitoring Plan (HMMP) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in compliance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: CCTV survey of existing drainage network

conditions.summary: Sustainable drainage scheme maintenance and management
conditions.text: The development hereby approved shall not be used until details of the maintenance and management of the sustainable drainage scheme have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The drainage scheme shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter managed and maintained in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity. The Local Planning Authority shall be granted access to inspect the sustainable drainage scheme for the lifetime of the development. The details of the scheme to be submitted for approval shall include: A timetable for its implementation. Details of SuDS feature and connecting drainage structures and maintenance requirement for each aspect including a drawing showing where they are located. A management and maintenance plan for the lifetime of the development which shall include the arrangements for adoption by any public body or statutory undertaker, or any other arrangements to secure the operation of the sustainable drainage scheme throughout its lifetime. This will include the name and contact details of any appointed management company.

conditions.summary: Surface water drainage system verification report
conditions.text: Upon completion of the surface water drainage system, including any SuDS features, and prior to the first use of the development; a survey and verification report from an independent surveyor shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The survey and report shall demonstrate that the surface water drainage system has been constructed in accordance with the details approved pursuant to condition [Condition 13]. Where necessary, details of corrective works to be carried out along with a timetable for their completion, shall be included for approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Any corrective works required shall be carried out in accordance with the approved timetable and subsequently re-surveyed with the findings submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Flood Emergency Plan
conditions.text: Prior to the first use of the development hereby permitted, a Flood Emergency Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing to the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in compliance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Post-construction validation report for residential amenity space noise limits
conditions.text: Three months before occupation of the residential units, a post-construction validation report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The post-construction validation report shall demonstrate that all residential units have access to outdoor amenity space where noise levels do not exceed 55dB LAeq (16 hour). Where the post-construction validation report specifies that mitigation measures are required to achieve 55dB LQeq (16 hour), then these mitigation measures must be completed prior to occupation of the residential units. These mitigation measures must thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Building services plant acoustic impact assessment (BS4142, 5dB attenuation)
conditions.text: For Block C and D, the operation of any building services plant, shall not commence until an assessment of the acoustic impact arising from the operation of all internally and externally located plant for those blocks has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. For Block B and E, the residential use shall not commence until an assessment of the acoustic impact of any building services (non-residential and residential) arising from the operation of all internally and externally located plant has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The assessment of the acoustic impact shall be undertaken in accordance with BS 4142: 2014 (or subsequent superseding equivalent) and current best practice, and shall include a scheme of attenuation measures to ensure the rating level of noise emitted from the proposed building services plant is 5db less than background.

conditions.summary: Residential amenity space noise levels (55dB LAEQ 16 hour)
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of above ground construction works for Block C and Block E a scheme of measures to ensure that all residential units have access to amenity space within the development where noise levels do not exceed 55dB LAEQ (16 hour) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The construction of Block B will be in accordance with the details approved under ref: 21/03922/NMC and Block D will be in accordance with the details approved under ref: 24/01436/DET unless alternative details are submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. A separate validation report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority 3 months prior to Occupation of the residential uses within a block.

conditions.summary: Community space noise control scheme (amplified music, bass frequency management)
conditions.text: Prior to occupation of the community space in Block E, a scheme of noise control shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority for that community space. The scheme shall be written by a suitably qualified person and shall specify but not be limited to: a) the noise level at which amplified entertainment or live music will be played b) the frequency with which amplified entertainment or live music shall be played c) the control measures that will be used and d) a complaint recording and management plan. The scheme shall not rely solely on BS4142 as the metric for compliance and must take due account of the bass frequency characteristics and the likely resulting noise levels within adjoining or close by residential properties. If anything other than ambient music is to be played, then design, installation and validation of a dedicated diffuse speaker array must be included in the plan. The development shall thereafter be carried out and operated in accordance with the approved plan for the duration of the use.

conditions.summary: Phasing Plan implementation
conditions.text: The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the Phasing Plan approved under ref: 21/01227/DET on 04/06/2021 and 25/02029/NMC unless an alternative plan is submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The plan shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Construction details for Blocks A, G and F
conditions.text: Block A shall be constructed in full accordance with the construction details approved under ref: 19/04452/DET on 29/01/2020 and ref: 20/01805/DET on 28/07/2020 and Block G under ref: 21/04268/DET on 18/01/2022 unless alternative plans are submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The details shall be implemented and maintained permanently thereafter. Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings, prior to the commencement of above first floor frame level works at and Block F, construction drawings (including sections at 1:10 scale of all external elements of the new structures (including rain water goods, soffits, copings, ledges, reveals and balcony screens where required) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and retained permanently thereafter.

conditions.summary: Brown roof details for Block F with biodiversity requirements
conditions.text: Block A shall be carried out in full accordance with the living roof details approved under ref: 19/04220/DET on 13/02/2020 and 23/02396/DET on 14/09/2023 and Block G in accordance with ref: 21/04184/DET approved on 20/06/2022 and permanently retained and maintained thereafter. No above first floor frame level construction works shall take place at Block F until full details of an extensive brown roof which shall be compliant with GRO Green Roof Code 2011 has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the implementation of the relevant part of the development hereby approved. The submission must provide/comprise the following information: a. Details on materials used in the design, construction and installation of the brown roof based on the Green Roof Code and the use of biodiversity based extensive/semi-intensive soils; b. Details on substrate and plants used in the brown roof, based on a commercial brick-based aggregate or equivalent with a varied substrate depth of 80 -150mm planted with 50% locally native herbs/wildflowers in addition to a variety of sedum species; c. Details on additional features to the proposed brown roof, such as areas of bare shingle, areas of sand for burrowing invertebrates and individual logs or log piles. d. An ecological management and maintenance plan including landscape features and a cross section of the brown roof.

conditions.summary: Noise and vibration attenuation scheme for Block F
conditions.text: Block A shall be carried out in full accordance with the scheme of noise and vibration attenuation approved under ref: 19/03643/DET on 22/11/2019 and Block G in accordance with ref: 21/03031/DET approved on 24/09/2021 unless alternative details are submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The details shall be implemented and maintained in working order for the duration of the use thereafter. Prior to the commencement of above first floor frame level construction works for Block F, a scheme of noise and vibration attenuation shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall achieve the habitable and commercial room standards as detailed in BS8233:2014 with no relaxation for exceptional circumstances and must include details of post construction validation. The approved noise and vibration attenuation measures shall thereafter be retained and maintained in working order for the duration of the use in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Noise attenuation and amenity space noise levels for Block F
conditions.text: Block A shall be carried out in full accordance with the noise attenuation details approved under ref: 19/02896/DET on 18/12/2019 and Block G in accordance with ref: 21/03020/DET approved on 24/09/2021 unless alternative details are submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The details shall be implemented and maintained in working order for the duration of the use thereafter. Prior to the commencement of above first floor frame level construction works for Block F, a scheme of measures to ensure that all residential units have access to amenity space within the development where noise levels do not exceed 55dB LAEQ(16 hour) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include details of post construction validation. Thereafter the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and a separate validation report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority 3 months prior to occupation.

conditions.summary: Energy details and carbon emissions calculations for Block F
conditions.text: Block A and Block G shall be carried out in full accordance with the energy details approved under 19/04218/DET on 10/07/2020 and under 22/00085/DET on 03/08/2022 respectively unless alternative details are submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The details shall be fully implemented thereafter. Prior to above first floor frame level construction works at Block F, full Design Stage calculations and block compliance sheets undertaken using the National Calculation Method demonstrating how carbon emissions have been minimised in line with the approved energy strategy for the residential element must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Solar PV array design and specifications for Block F
conditions.text: Block A shall be carried out in accordance with the solar PV details approved under 19/04282/DET on 29/01/2020 and Block G shall be carried out in accordance with solar PV details approved under ref: 21/04184/DET on 20/06/2022. Prior to above first floor frame level construction works at Block F, plans, elevations and sections of the roof showing the photovoltaic array should be submitted for approval to the Local Planning Authority showing how the required quantity of PV will be accommodated, along with a full BRUKL Design stage assessment showing the same quantity of PV and demonstrating at least a 35% reduction in emissions across all sustainability measures. The photovoltaic array shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and retained and properly maintained permanently thereafter.

conditions.summary: Detailed drainage scheme with SuDS and rainwater harvesting
conditions.text: The development of Block A and Block G shall be carried out in full accordance with the drainage details approved under ref: 19/03252/DET on 27/11/2019 unless alternative plans are submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The details shall be implemented and maintained permanently thereafter. No above first floor frame level construction of Block F shall commence until a detailed drainage scheme designed with regard to the drainage hierarchy set out in the London Plan, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The drainage scheme shall be implemented and maintained in accordance with the approved details and retained permanently thereafter. No discharge of foul or surface water from the site shall be accepted into the public system until the drainage works referred to in the strategy have been completed. No drainage systems for the infiltration of surface water drainage into the ground are permitted other than with the express written consent of the Local Planning Authority. The drainage scheme shall include: a) The final surface water drainage design to scale, showing all connections, SuDS and water storage details for the entire site b) Details of how the scheme achieves betterment compared to the existing peak surface water runoff rates from the site c) Details of a rainwater harvest system d) Details of how trees and planters will be located to maximise betterment e) Any offsite consents required, such as agreed surface water discharge consents from Thames Water Utilities f) A maintenance and management plan for the proposed drainage scheme

No above first floor frame construction works to Block E shall take place until full details of an extensive brown roof which shall be compliant with GRO Green Roof Code 2011 has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the implementation of the relevant part of the development hereby approved. The submission must provide/comprise the following information: a. Details on materials used in the design, construction and installation of the brown roof based on the Green Roof Code and the use of biodiversity based extensive/semi-intensive soils; b. Details on substrate and plants used in the brown roof, based on a commercial brick-based aggregate or equivalent with a varied substrate depth of 80 -150mm planted with 50% locally native herbs/wildflowers in addition to a variety of sedum species; c. Details on additional features to the proposed brown roof, such as areas of bare shingle, areas of sand for burrowing invertebrates and individual logs or log piles. d. An ecological management and maintenance plan including landscape features and a cross section of the brown roof. The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details approved unless alternative details are submitted to and approved, and shall be maintained as such thereafter and no alterations to the approved scheme shall be permitted without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority. Evidence that the brown roof has been installed in accordance with the details above should be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority prior to final occupation of each Block.

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with approved plans
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans listed in the Plans and Specifications above. For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

conditions.summary: External walling materials samples and approval
conditions.text: Construction of external walls to any building subject of this permission shall not take place until details and samples of all external walling materials have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The walls shall be constructed from the approved materials.

conditions.summary: Noise management plan for vehicle sounders and loading bays
conditions.text: Prior to occupation, a noise management plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The plan shall detail the measures that will be taken to effectively control noise arising at the premises from all likely noise sources so that it does not have an adverse impact on nearby residents. The plan shall include a scheme to deal with noise from: Vehicle reversing sounders; Use of specific loading bays at night-time to minimise impact at dwellings on Farm Hill Road. The approved noise management plan shall be fully implemented before use commences and operated in accordance with the approved plan thereafter.

conditions.summary: BREEAM design stage and final certification
conditions.text: Prior to the occupation of the development design stage certification and final BREEAM certification shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: As-built BRUKL report submission and approval
conditions.text: Prior to the occupation of the development an as-built BRUKL report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Solar thermal, PV and ASHP location and capacity confirmation
conditions.text: Prior to the occupation of the development the details of the location and designed capacity of the solar thermal, PVs and ASHP is to be confirmed and shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Cycle and motorcycle parking provision and retention
conditions.text: Development shall not be occupied until the approved cycle/motorcycle parking and facilities have been provided. The approved facilities shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Electric Vehicle Charging Points provision and retention
conditions.text: Development shall not be occupied until Electric Vehicle Charging Points have been provided in accordance with a scheme that shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Tree, hedge and shrub replacement within five years
conditions.text: If within a period of five years from the date of the planting of any tree/hedge/shrub that tree/hedge/shrub, or any replacement, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective, another tree/hedge/shrub of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted in the same location as soon as reasonably possible and no later than the first available planting season, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Tree protection fencing, arboricultural method statement and notices
conditions.text: a) No works on any part of the site shall commence until all existing trees, hedges, bushes shown to be retained on the approved plans for that area of the site are fully safeguarded by protective fencing and ground protection in accordance with approved plans and specifications and the provisions of British Standard 5837 (2012) Trees in relation to design, demolition and construction. b) No works or development shall commence on any part of the site until a written arboricultural method statement for a tree care plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. c) No equipment, machinery or materials shall be used, stored or burnt within any protected area. Ground levels within these areas shall not be altered, nor any excavations undertaken including the provision of any underground services, without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority. d) Seven days written notice shall be given to the Local Planning Authority that the protection measures are in place prior to demolition and/or approved works.

conditions.summary: Hydraulic assessment of surface water drainage strategy
conditions.text: The development shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved scheme before the development is brought into use, specifically: Development shall not commence until a hydraulic assessment of the proposed surface water drainage strategy has been submitted and approved. Such hydraulic assessment shall use FEH 13 rainfall data set and shall ensure compliance with the following criteria: (i) For the 50% AEP (1 in 2 year) storm event no pipe surcharge (with exceptions to be agreed) (ii) For the 3.33% AEP (1 in 30 year) storm event no surface flooding (iii) For the 1% AEP (1 in 100 year) storm event plus 30% climate change allowance no property flooding with any floodwater retained within the extent of the site.

conditions.summary: CCTV and security system approval and details
conditions.text: No CCTV or other security system shall be installed on any unit until full details of proposals have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details shall include the location and height of any column or supporting structure, position of cameras, field of view and management of surveillance. All equipment shall then be installed in accordance with approved details and retained as such thereafter.

applications.address: Moorfield House Nursing Home Fieldhouse Walk Moortown Leeds LS17 6HW
applications.description: Conversion of care home into a mixed-use scheme comprising 14 apartments and serviced office accommodation space including alterations and extensions to existing building; alterations to landscaping including new car park, bin and cycle stores, widening of access driveway, access ramp and amenity areas

conditions.summary: Three year time limit for commencement
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with approved plans
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans listed in the Plans and Specifications above.

conditions.summary: Maximum apartment occupancy restrictions
conditions.text: The following apartments, as shown on the approved plans, shall have a maximum permanent occupancy at any one time of the following: Apartment 7 - no more than one person; Apartments 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11, 13 - no more than three persons

conditions.summary: Office use operational hours restriction
conditions.text: The hours of use of the proposed office development shall be restricted to Monday to Friday from 8am to 7pm each day. The offices shall be closed during weekends and public holidays.

conditions.summary: Drainage strategy in accordance with approved scheme
conditions.text: The development shall be undertaken in accordance with the Dart Engineers Ltd Drainage strategy Drg No 23331/DR/C/0100 rev P1 and Dart Engineers Drainage Calculations ref 23331.pdf dated 21/06/23, unless otherwise submitted and approved in writing with the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be fully implemented in accordance with the approved scheme before the development is brought into use, or as set out in the approved phasing details.

conditions.summary: Surface water discharge restrictions pending completion of drainage works
conditions.text: There shall be no piped discharge of surface water from the development prior to the completion of surface water drainage works, unless otherwise agreed by the local planning authority. If discharge to public sewer is proposed, the information shall include evidence that other means of surface water drainage have been properly considered and why they have been discounted; and the means of discharging to the public sewer network at a rate to be agreed by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with the statutory sewerage undertaker.

conditions.summary: Carbon reduction measures for policy compliance
conditions.text: Prior to construction of the external works to the building at the site, confirmation of the methods of carbon reduction to serve the development, including locations and timeframes for installation, to achieve a policy compliant scheme with Core Strategy policy EN1 shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The agreed scheme of measures shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the building and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Water efficiency measures and compliance verification
conditions.text: Prior to the first occupation of the building, details and specifications of water efficiency measures which have been installed to ensure compliance with Core Strategy policy EN2 (including water efficiency calculations) shall be provided to the local planning authority. Such measures shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Unexpected contamination discovery and remediation protocol
conditions.text: The Local Planning Authority shall be notified in writing immediately where unexpected significant contamination is encountered during any development works and operations in the affected part of the site shall cease. Where remediation is necessary, a Remediation Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to recommencement of development. The site shall not be brought into use until all necessary verification information has been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. In the event that no unexpected significant contamination is encountered, written confirmation shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation of the site.

conditions.summary: Testing and approval of imported soils and materials
conditions.text: Any soil or soil forming materials brought to site for use in garden areas, soft landscaping, public open space or for filling and level raising shall be tested for contamination and suitability for use. A methodology for testing these soils shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority prior to these materials being imported onto site. Relevant evidence, assessment and verification information shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority prior to the site being brought into use. In the event that no soil or soil forming materials have been brought to site, written confirmation shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Landscape scheme and biodiversity net gain details
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the details on the approved plans, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until full details of both hard and soft landscape works, including a dated implementation programme, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details shall include finished levels, boundary details, car parking layouts with EV charging, hard surfacing, tree planting with RPAs, planting plans, written specifications, plant schedules, drainage proposals, and details and specifications as to how a biodiversity net gain will be achieved at the site in accordance with Core Strategy policy G9. All works shall be carried out in accordance with approved details, BS 4428:1989 and Leeds City Council landscape guidance.

conditions.summary: Revised Arboricultural Method Statement in accordance with BS5837
conditions.text: No landscaping works shall commence until a revised written Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) has been provided to correlate with the approved layout of the scheme in accordance with BS5837 for a tree care plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The AMS shall include an annotated plan showing all protection measures, protective fencing and ground protection specifications, details of how exclusion zones are to be enforced, and a schedule of works to ensure protection measures are in place prior to landscaping works commencing with photographic evidence and suitable arboricultural supervision at appropriate stages.

conditions.summary: Protection of retained trees, hedges and bushes for five years
conditions.text: Within 5 years of first use of the new soft landscaping areas, no approved retained tree/hedge/bushes shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed nor any tree be pruned, topped or lopped or suffer root severance (other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars) without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Access ramp installation prior to first occupation
conditions.text: The proposed access ramp as shown on the approved plans shall be installed and made available for use prior to the first occupation of the residential apartments hereby approved.

conditions.summary: External plant details, specifications and noise assessment
conditions.text: Prior to the installation of any external plant, details, specifications and locations of the plant shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. Submitted details shall include noise information and an assessment of the impacts for residential occupiers of the development. The approved scheme shall be implemented and retained for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Construction Method Statement covering site management
conditions.text: Prior to works commencing, including any demolition, a Construction Method Statement shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Statement shall provide for: (i) the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors; (ii) details of access, storage, parking, loading and unloading of all contractors' plant, equipment, materials and vehicles (including workforce parking); (iii) storage of plant and materials; (iv) the erection and maintenance of security hoarding; (v) wheel washing facilities; (vi) measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during demolition and construction; and (vii) details of construction hours. The approved Statement shall be adhered to throughout the construction period.

conditions.summary: Construction Environmental Management Plan (Biodiversity)
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of any landscaping works, a Construction Environmental Management Plan (CEMP:Biodiversity) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The CEMP (Biodiversity) shall include: a) Risk assessment of potentially damaging construction activities; b) Identification of 'biodiversity protection zones'; c) Measures to avoid or reduce impacts during construction; d) Location and timings of sensitive works to avoid harm to biodiversity features, including nesting birds; e) Times when specialist ecologists need to be present on site; f) Role of Ecological Clerk of Works and lines of communication; g) Use of protective fences, exclusion barriers and warning signs. The approved CEMP shall be adhered to and implemented throughout the construction period strictly in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Cycle and motorcycle parking and facilities provision
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the approved details, prior to the first occupation of the development, full details of cycle/motorcycle parking and facilities shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved cycle/motorcycle parking and facilities shall thereafter be provided prior to first occupation of the development and retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Electric Vehicle Charging Points installation and maintenance
conditions.text: The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until the approved Electric Vehicle Charging Points, cable enabled spaces and associated infrastructure have been provided. The facilities shall thereafter be retained and maintained as approved for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Window condition survey and repair/replacement methodology
conditions.text: Prior to the installation of any new window, a window condition survey, including supporting photographs, shall be submitted to the local planning authority. Where windows are proposed to be repaired, a methodology for repair by a suitably qualified historic window specialist shall be provided. Where windows are proposed to be replaced, justification for replacement, cross sections with glazing details and profile information, confirmation of materials and proposed finish, opening pattern, and set back location within the window reveal shall be provided. The windows shall thereafter be repaired or replaced in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: New external door specification and materials approval
conditions.text: Prior to the installation of any new external door, full specification details of the new door, including details of materials and finish, shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The new doors shall thereafter be installed in accordance with the agreed details.

conditions.summary: External stonework cleaning details and justification
conditions.text: Prior to any cleaning of external stonework, full details of the cleaning works to be undertaken, including justification for the works from a suitably qualified heritage professional, shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The cleaning shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the agreed details.

conditions.summary: New stonework details, mortar mix and sample panel approval
conditions.text: Prior to the erection of any new stonework, full details of the new stonework including mortar mix and joining materials to be used (including a sample panel to be erected on site where requested by the local planning authority) shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The stonework shall thereafter be erected in accordance with the agreed details.

conditions.summary: External items (rainwater goods, etc.) details and approval
conditions.text: Prior to the addition of any new external items, such as and including rainwater goods or protuberances, full details of the such items shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The works shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the agreed details.

applications.description: Listed Building Application for conversion of care home into a mixed-use scheme comprising 14 apartments and serviced office accommodation space including alterations and extensions to existing building; alterations to landscaping including new car park, bin and cycle stores, widening of access driveway, access ramp and amenity areas; demolition of external stairs and internal walls

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with approved plans

conditions.summary: Landscape and biodiversity net gain details
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the details on the approved plans, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until full details of both hard and soft landscape works, including a dated implementation programme (inclusive of any phasing), have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Hard landscape works shall include: (a) proposed finished levels and/or contours, (b) boundary details, means of enclosure and retaining structures, (c) car parking layouts including the location and specification of electric vehicle charging points, (d) other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas, (e) hard surfacing areas, (f) minor artefacts, structures (e.g. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc.) and external lighting including measures for bat and bird boxes/infrastructure, Soft landscape works shall include: (g) details of tree planting (including related underground infrastructure to accommodate tree root growth) and hedge planting (including measures to create sufficient space for root growth) in the proposed car parking area, (h) planting plans (display existing trees with Root Protection Areas (RPAs) and all other retained vegetation), (i) written specifications (including soil depths, cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment) and (j) schedules of plants noting species, planting sizes, root packaging and proposed numbers/densities, (k) drainage proposals and any underground infrastructure. (l) details and specifications as to how a biodiversity net gain will be achieved at the site in accordance with Core Strategy policy G9.

conditions.summary: Window condition survey and repair/replacement specification
conditions.text: Prior to the installation of any new window, a window condition survey, including supporting photographs, shall be submitted to the local planning authority. Where windows are proposed to be repaired the following details shall be provided: - a methodology for the repair of each window to be undertaken by a suitably qualified historic window specialist. Where windows are proposed to be replaced the following details shall be provided: - a justification for why windows have to be replaced rather than are being capable of being repaired, - cross sections with glazing details and profile information, - confirmation of materials and proposed finish, - opening pattern, - Set back location within the window reveal. The windows shall thereafter be repaired or replaced in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: New door specification details
conditions.text: Prior to the installation of any new door, full specification details of the new door, including details of materials and finish, shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The new doors shall thereafter be installed in accordance with the agreed details.

conditions.summary: External stonework cleaning specification
conditions.text: Prior to any cleaning of external stonework, full details of the cleaning works to be undertaken, including justification for the works from a suitably qualified heritage professional, shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The cleaning shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the agreed details.

conditions.summary: New stonework specification and mortar details
conditions.text: Prior to the erection of any new stonework, full details of the new stonework including mortar mix and joining materials to be used (including a sample panel to be erected on site where requested by the local planning authority) shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The stonework shall thereafter be erected in accordance with the agreed details.

conditions.summary: External materials specification including rainwater goods
conditions.text: Prior to the addition of any new external materials, including rainwater goods or protuberances, full details of the external materials shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The works shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the agreed details.

applications.description: Reserved Matters approval for the layout, scale, appearance, landscaping and access for the construction of a single warehouse and distribution unit (Use Class B8) and associated infrastructure and landscaping and earthworks

conditions.summary: Compliance with approved plans
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans listed in the Plans and Specifications above. For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

conditions.summary: Construction Traffic Management Plan
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of the development hereby permitted a Construction Traffic Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority (in consultation with the Highway Authority for the M1 Motorway). The plan shall include as a minimum: - Construction phasing; - Construction routing plans; - Permitted construction traffic arrival and departure times. Thereafter all construction activity in respect of the development shall be undertaken in full accordance with such approved details unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority (in consultation with the Highways Authority).

conditions.summary: Statement of Construction Practice
conditions.text: No works shall begin on the relevant phase of development until a Statement of Construction Practice for that phase has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Statement of Construction Practice shall include full details of: a) the methods to be employed to prevent mud, grit and dirt being carried onto the public highway from the development hereby approved; b) measures to control the emissions of dust and dirt during construction; c) location of site compound and plant equipment/storage; and d) how this Statement of Construction Practice will be made publicly available by the developer.

conditions.summary: Coal mining intrusive investigations and remediation
conditions.text: No above ground development shall commence until; a) a scheme of intrusive investigations has been carried out on site to establish the risks posed to the development by coal mining activity, including that posed by past shallow and opencast coal mining activity, and b) any remediation works and/or mitigation measures to address land instability arising from coal mining legacy, as may be necessary, have been implemented on site in full in order to ensure that the site is made safe and stable for the development proposed.

conditions.summary: Coal mining safety statement prior to occupation
conditions.text: Prior to the occupation of the development, or it being taken into beneficial use, a signed statement or declaration prepared by a suitably competent person confirming that the site is, or has been made, safe and stable for the approved development shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing. This document shall confirm the methods and findings of the intrusive site investigations and the completion of any remedial works and/or mitigation necessary to address the risks posed by past coal mining activity.

conditions.summary: Tree protection and arboricultural supervision
conditions.text: a) No works shall commence (including any site clearance, groundworks or drainage etc.) until all existing trees, hedges and vegetation shown to be retained on submitted Drwg. No. DR-6837-01 Rev F (Landscape Masterplan) are fully safeguarded by protective fencing and ground protection in accordance with approved plans and specifications and the provisions of British Standard 5837 (2012) Trees in relation to design, demolition and construction, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such measures shall be retained for the full duration of any demolition and/or approved works. b) No works or development shall commence until an updated written Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) in accordance with BS5837 for a tree care plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.

conditions.summary: Archaeological recording programme
conditions.text: No development to take place until the applicant, or their agents or successors in title, has secured the implementation of a programme of archaeological recording. This recording must be carried out by an appropriately qualified and experienced archaeological organisation or consultant, in accordance with a written scheme of investigation which has been submitted by the applicant and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Control and eradication of invasive species
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of development, including ground works and site preparations, a Method Statement for the control and eradication of Himalayan Balsam and Giant Hogweed (hereafter referred to as the Target Species) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Method Statement will include post-treatment monitoring of the site to ensure a continuous 12-month period of time occurs where none of the Target Species is identified growing on the whole site.

conditions.summary: Lighting Design Strategy for Bats
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of above ground development a Lighting Design Strategy For Bats shall be produced by an appropriately qualified ecological consultant and submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The Strategy shall: a) Identify those areas/features on site that are particularly sensitive for roosting, commuting or foraging bats- using an appropriately scaled map to show where these areas are b) Show how and where external lighting will be installed (through the provision of appropriate lighting contour plans and technical specifications) so that it can be clearly demonstrated that areas to be lit will not disturb commuting and foraging bats

conditions.summary: Site access works off Aire Valley Avenue
conditions.text: Prior to the occupation of the development details of works comprising the site access off Aire Valley Avenue, as indicated in Drwg. No. 020672-RPS-SI-XX-DR-A-0094 Rev P06 Unit 6- Proposed Site Plan, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved works shall be fully implemented prior to occupation.

conditions.summary: Electric Vehicle Charging Points and cable enabled parking
conditions.text: The development shall not be brought into use until the Electric Vehicle Charging Points and cable enabled parking spaces for this unit, as indicated in Drwg. No. 020672-RPS-SI-XX-DR-A-0094 Rev P06 Unit 6- Proposed Site Plan, have been provided in accordance with the standards set out in the Council's Transport SPD. The facilities shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Cycle parking facilities provision
conditions.text: The development shall not be brought into use until the approved cycle parking facilities associated with the unit's operation have been provided. The approved facilities shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Vehicular and pedestrian access gradients
conditions.text: The vehicular access gradient shall not exceed 1 in 40 (2.5%) for the first 15m and 1 in 20 (5%) thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The gradient of the pedestrian access shall not exceed 1 in 20 (5%).

conditions.summary: Ground levels and site levels details
conditions.text: Development shall not commence until details of existing and proposed ground levels, including soft landscape areas, paths, internal roads, walls and parking areas and the finished floor levels of the approved building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Commencement within three years
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with approved plans
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans listed in the Plans and Specifications above.

conditions.summary: External walls and roofs materials approval
conditions.text: Construction of external walls and roofs (including dormers) to any building subject of this permission shall not take place until details and samples of all external walling and roofing materials have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Samples shall be made available on site prior to the commencement of building works, for inspection by the Local Planning Authority which shall be notified in writing of their availability. The building works shall be constructed from the materials thereby approved.

conditions.summary: Vehicle parking, roads and drainage provision
conditions.text: Development shall not be occupied until all areas shown on the approved plans to be used by vehicles, including roads, footpaths, cycle tracks, loading and servicing areas and vehicle parking space have been fully laid out, surfaced and drained such that loose materials and surface water does not discharge or transfer onto the highway. These areas shall not be used for any other purpose thereafter.

conditions.summary: Bin stores and waste collection facilities
conditions.text: The approved details for the provision of bin stores (including siting, materials and means of enclosure) and (where applicable) storage of wastes and access for their collection shall be implemented in full before the use commences and shall be retained thereafter as such for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Cycle and motorcycle parking provision
conditions.text: Development shall not be occupied until the approved cycle/motorcycle parking and facilities have been provided. The approved facilities shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Vehicular access to site
conditions.text: Means of vehicular access to and from the site shall only be as shown on the approved plan 387/03 Rev. A; and delivered prior to first occupation and retained thereafter for the lifetime of the proposed development.

conditions.summary: Phase II Site Investigation and Remediation Strategy
conditions.text: The approved Phase I Desk Study report indicates that a Phase II Site Investigation is necessary, and therefore development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Phase II Site Investigation Report has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Where remediation measures are shown to be necessary in the Phase II Report and/or where soil or soil forming material is being imported to site, development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Remediation Strategy demonstrating how the site will be made suitable for the intended use has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Management of unexpected contamination
conditions.text: If remediation is unable to proceed in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy, or where significant unexpected contamination is encountered, or where soil or soil forming material is being imported to site, the Local Planning Authority shall be notified in writing immediately and operations on the affected part of the site shall cease. The affected part of the site shall be agreed with the Local Planning Authority in writing. An amended or new Remediation Strategy and/or Soil Importation Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to any further remediation works.

conditions.summary: Remediation works and verification reports
conditions.text: Remediation works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy. On completion of those works, the Verification Report(s) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in accordance with the approved programme. The site or phase of a site shall not be brought into use until such time as all verification information has been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Hard and soft landscaping works
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until full details of both hard and soft landscape works, including a dated implementation programme (inclusive of any phasing), have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Hard landscape works shall include (a) boundary details, means of enclosure and retaining structures, (b) hard surfacing areas. Soft landscape works shall include (c) planting plans (display existing trees with Root Protection Areas (RPAs) and all other retained vegetation), (d) written specifications (including soil depths, cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment) and (e) schedules of plants noting species, planting sizes, root packaging and proposed numbers/densities, (f) drainage proposals.

conditions.text: The stone wall, along the site frontage of St Pauls Street and along the west boundary nearest the access point, shall be retained and maintained, as is, for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.text: The design of new windows shall match the style, materials and colour of the existing windows and be retained and maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Notification and revised strategy if unexpected contamination encountered

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with approved plans
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans listed in the Plans and Specifications above.

conditions.summary: Construction materials to match approved plans
conditions.text: The proposal shall be constructed of the same materials detailed on the approved plans.
