The approved charging facilities shall thereafter be retained and maintained as approved for the lifetime of the development.

applications.address: Leeds United A F C Ltd Elland Road Beeston Leeds LS11 0ES
applications.description: Hybrid planning application for partial redevelopment of the existing stadium and surroundings, comprising: (i) Full planning application for the partial demolition and redevelopment of the West Stand to provide stadium seating, hospitality, food/beverage, retail, museum and/or related uses; hard/soft landscaping works; parking and access; and associated works; (ii) Full planning application for coach parking, including boundary treatments, hard/soft landscaping and associated works; (iii) Demolition of existing buildings and structures; (iv) full planning application for temporary works including hard/soft landscaping and parking; and (iv) Outline planning application for the partial demolition and redevelopment of the North Stand to provide stadium seating, hospitality, food/beverage, and/or related uses; hard/soft landscaping; and associated works. NON MATERIAL AMENDMENT to 25/04000/FU A revised roof truss is now proposed. The updated design is smaller in scale, resulting in an overall reduction in the height of the truss by approximately 7.8m.

applications.address: 16 Spring Close Street Cross Green Leeds LS9 8RT
applications.description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) and removal of conditions 5 (footway crossing) and 6 (EVCP) to previously approved planning application 23/00716/FU (Part conversion of warehouse to form three flats) for omission of widened vehicle access via spring close street and omission of widened door and basement vehicle parking and EVCP provision

applications.address: Leeds United A F C Ltd Elland Road Beeston Leeds LS11 0ES
applications.description: Hybrid planning application for partial redevelopment of the existing stadium and surroundings, comprising: (i) Full planning application for the partial demolition and redevelopment of the West Stand to provide stadium seating, hospitality, food/beverage, retail, museum and/or related uses; hard/soft landscaping works; parking and access; and associated works; (ii) Full planning application for coach parking, including boundary treatments, hard/soft landscaping and associated works; (iii) Demolition of existing buildings and structures; (iv) full planning application for temporary works including hard/soft landscaping and parking; and (iv) Outline planning application for the partial demolition and redevelopment of the North Stand to provide stadium seating, hospitality, food/beverage, and/or related uses; hard/soft landscaping; and associated works. - NON MATERIAL AMENDMENT TO 25/04000/FU - Amend the trigger of Conditions 41 & 43.

conditions.summary: Supplementary Transport Assessment and Event Management Plan
conditions.text: A supplementary Transport Assessment (TA), and an Event Management Plan (EMP) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with National Highways. The supplementary TA and EMP shall be submitted for approval in accordance with the timescales outlined in the approved "Highways Information Programme 14.07.26 V1" unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

conditions.summary: Temporary Traffic and Event Management Plan for each phase
conditions.text: A Temporary Traffic and Event Management Plan (TTEMP) for each phase shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, in consultation with the Highway Authority and relevant strategic highway authorities. The TTEMP shall be submitted for approval in accordance with the timescales outlined in the approved "Highways Information Programme 14.07.26 V1" unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority. The approved TTEMP shall be implemented in full for the duration of the relevant phase and for all event-day operations and thereafter maintained unless agreed in writing. No occupation of the development in each phase shall take place until all mitigation measures identified by the TTEMP are implemented, and written confirmation of such implementation has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with National Highways

applications.address: Verity House 6 Canal Wharf Holbeck Leeds LS11 5BQ
applications.description: Change of use from offices (use Class E) to hotel accommodation with restaurant/ bar and back of house facilities (Use Class C1) including single storey upward extension, four-storey side extension and associated works - NON-MATERIAL AMENDMENT to 25/02779/FU - Non-material amendment to the schedule of approved plans listed under condition number 2 in addition to amending condition number 24 - In order to omit solar PV panels from roof of development and update energy strategy accordingly

conditions.summary: Energy Strategy implementation and Low Zero Carbon technologies approval
conditions.text: The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy (C9091-TLP-00 XX-R-BP-100 P02), subject to any amendment of those details agreed pursuant to this condition. In addition to the details already approved, and prior to commencement of the development, the following details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority: a) A completed 'as-designed' Carbon and Energy Reporting Template (CERT V1.0) b) General contract specifications including capacity and location details of all the proposed Low Zero Carbon (LZC) technologies. The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details. In the interests of achieving a sustainable form of development.

applications.address: Little Casterton Road Stamford Road Little Casterton Rutland
applications.description: Cross Boundary Outline Planning application with all matters reserved except Access for up to 1,350 no. residential units (use Classes C2 and C3); two form entry primary school (use class F.1); local centre uses (use classes E and F2, public house, wine bar, or drinking establishment, drinking establishment with expanded food provision, hot food takeaway for the sale of hot food where consumption of that food is mostly undertaken off the premises); removal of existing bund; associated green infrastructure including provision of public open space, landscaping, formal and informal play areas; utilities (including drainage); and associated access, ancillary works and structures. THIS APPLICATION ONLY RELATES TO ACCESS FROM LITTLE CASTERTON ROAD.

conditions.summary: Commencement within two years of last reserved matters approval
conditions.text: The development shall be begun before the expiration of two years from the date of approval of the last of the reserved matters to be approved.

conditions.summary: Reserved matters submission and approval required
conditions.text: No development shall be commenced until plans and particulars of the reserved matters referred to in the above conditions relating to the access, appearance, landscaping, layout and scale have been submitted to and approved, in writing, by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Reserved matters application within eight years
conditions.text: Application for approval of the reserved matters shall be made to the Local Planning Authority before the expiration of eight years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: Strategic foul water drainage strategy and connection point
conditions.text: No development shall commence until a strategic foul water strategy has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, in consultation with Anglian Water. This strategy should identify the connection point to the 1050mm sewer network along Uffington Road unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with Anglian Water. The foul water drainage works relating to the approved works must be carried out in complete accordance with the approved scheme.

conditions.summary: Protection of Local Wildlife Site verges during construction
conditions.text: No development shall commence until a detailed scheme setting out any features of the verges to the north of the site on Little Casterton Road requiring protection from the proposed development during the construction phase, and the means of such protection has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved measures shall be installed at the site prior to the commencement of works in relation to this permission and shall be retained throughout the duration of the construction phase of the development. No construction works or storage of materials shall take place within the protected areas.

conditions.summary: Construction traffic routing restriction from Little Casterton Road north
conditions.text: No construction traffic shall access the wider development site from the north via Little Casterton Road.

conditions.summary: Active Travel Route completion before closure of existing route
conditions.text: Closure or construction of the repurposed route of Little Casterton Road for an Active Travel Route shall not commence until the entire diverted route of carriageways and footways are fully completed to surface course level.

applications.address: The Barn 35A Main Street Empingham Rutland LE15 8PR
applications.description: To install a Solar PV array of 8 x 620w PV panels on the flat roof, with battery storage. The array will be mounted on a MCS approved flat roof mounting system and will also include an inverter and battery.

conditions.summary: Commencement of development within three years
conditions.text: The development shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with submitted plans and details
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans: Location and Block Plan received 31 October 2023; Photo of Proposed Siting received 31 October 2023; Photo - proposed Solar Panels received 31 October 2023; Solar Panel Product Details received 7 November 2023; Support System Specification received 7 November 2023; Photo 1 Existing Elevations received 7 November 2023; Photo 2 Existing Elevations received 7 November 2023; Photo 3 - Elevations 1 of 2 received 27 November 2023; Photo 4 - Elevations 2 of 2 received 27 November 2023; Details specified on the application form.

applications.address: Oak House Main Street Greetham Rutland LE15 7NL
applications.description: Change of Use of Existing Residential Care Home buildings and post office to 5 Private Dwellings, including demolitions and alterations

conditions.summary: Development commencement within three years
conditions.text: The development shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with submitted plans
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans: Site Location Plan, GH-24-13 Proposed Elevations, GH-24-11 Proposed Floor Plans, GH-24-10A Parking Plan

conditions.summary: Materials as specified in application
conditions.text: The development shall be carried out using the materials as specified within the application.

conditions.summary: Boundary treatment details approval
conditions.text: Before the first occupation of any dwelling hereby approved, details of all boundary treatment shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details prior to the first occupation of the dwelling to which the details relate and shall thereafter be so retained.

conditions.summary: Tree protection in accordance with BS5837:2012
conditions.text: No development shall take place until all trees to be retained have been protected in accordance with BS5837:2012. The protective measures shall be retained throughout the duration of demolition, building and engineering works in the vicinity of the trees to be protected. Within the Construction Exclusion Zone, the existing ground level shall be neither raised nor lowered, and no materials or temporary building or surplus soil shall be placed or stored there. If any trenches for services are required, they shall be excavated and backfilled by hand and any tree roots encountered with a diameter of 5cm or more shall be left unsevered.

conditions.summary: Hard and soft landscaping scheme approval
conditions.text: No above ground development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved, in writing, by the Local Planning Authority a scheme of hard and soft landscaping works for the site, which shall include any proposed changes in ground levels and also accurately identify spread, girth and species of all existing trees, shrubs and hedgerows on the site and indicate any to be retained.

conditions.summary: Landscaping implementation and maintenance
conditions.text: All changes in ground levels, hard landscaping, planting, seeding or turfing shown on the approved landscaping details shall be carried out during the first planting and seeding season (October - March inclusive) following the commencement of the development or in such other phased arrangement as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Any trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years of being planted die are removed or seriously damaged or seriously diseased shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size and species.

conditions.summary: Ecology survey mitigation measures
conditions.text: The development shall be carried out in accordance with the mitigation measures set out in Updated Ecology Survey 3rd June 2024.

conditions.summary: Obscure glazing to side-facing bedroom window Unit 1
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3, Schedule 2, Part 1 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order (England) 2015 (or any Order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), the side facing bedroom window serving Unit 1 on the approved plan shall be glazed in obscure glass to a level equivalent to Pilkington Level 3 or above before the dwelling hereby permitted is first occupied and shall thereafter be permanently retained in this approved form.

conditions.summary: Restriction on enlargement and building works
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3, Schedule 2, Part 1 Classes A-E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order (or any Order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no enlargement, improvement or other alteration to the dwelling, and no provision of buildings, enclosures, swimming or other pool, shall be erected or carried out except with prior planning permission.

conditions.summary: Flood risk mitigation measures including doorway protection
conditions.text: The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the mitigation measures as set out in the Michael Evans Flood Risk Assessment 14/03/2024 prior to the first occupation of any dwelling hereby approved. This shall include doorway flood protection for plots 4 and 5.

conditions.summary: External lighting details approval
conditions.text: Before the first occupation of any dwelling hereby approved, details of external lighting on the building and within the grounds, shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details.

conditions.summary: Access widening to 5m
conditions.text: The access shall be widened to 5m as shown on the approved plan GH-24-10A prior to the first occupation of any dwelling hereby approved and shall thereafter be retained in accordance with the approved plan.

conditions.summary: Car parking and turning provision
conditions.text: Car parking and turning shall be provided in accordance with plan GH-24-10A prior to the first occupation of any dwelling hereby approved and shall thereafter be retained in perpetuity and not used for any other purpose other than the parking and turning of vehicles.

conditions.summary: Access surface water drainage
conditions.text: The existing access and extension thereof must incorporate a method of surface water drainage to ensure that no private surface water can flow on to the public highway prior to the first occupation of any dwelling hereby approved and shall thereafter be so maintained.

conditions.summary: Construction Management Plan
conditions.text: No development shall take place, including any demolition work, until a Construction Management Plan has been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, which will include the following:- a) A scheme for monitoring, reporting and control of construction noise and vibration including hours of working and scope for remedial action b) A scheme for the control of dust and scope for remedial action in the event that dust is identified as an issue or any complaints are received c) Details of a chassis and wheel cleaning system to be used for all construction vehicles leaving the site in the event the internal vehicular route becomes muddied and if necessary, the temporary cessation of all construction vehicle movements whilst the area is cleaned together with any affected public highway which will be thoroughly cleaned immediately with mechanical sweepers. d) Haul routes to the site and hours of delivery e) Measures to ensure that vehicles entering the site can do so immediately upon arrival. f) Details to ensure that any parking, waiting, loading/unloading only occurs in the marked out parking bay directly adjacent to the site, which may involve a management of deliveries of materials etc. g) Details of any events that is likely to require a banksman for larger vehicles to reverse in to the site and methodology which is likely to require advanced warning of arrival h) Details of site compounds, storage area and contractor/visitor parking/turning i) Details of the site enclosure or part thereof and gated site security j) Confirmation that any demolition will be carried out in accordance with the ecological assessment k) Details of site notice with contact details and a scheme for dealing with complaints l) Details of any temporary lighting which must not directly light the public highway m) A scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from the demolition and construction works n) The erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Management Plan.

applications.address: Land To The South Of Pilton Village Luffenham Lane Pilton Rutland
applications.description: Full Planning Application for the installation and operation of a solar farm together with all associated works, equipment, necessary infrastructure and biodiversity enhancement areas.

conditions.summary: Time limit for commencement (three years)
conditions.text: The development shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: Accordance with approved plans and documents
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the details shown in the following approved documents and plans: [lists 23 approved drawings and documents including Site Location Plan, Landscape Proposals, Site Layout, Infrastructure drawings, Landscape and Ecological Management Plan, Construction Traffic Management Plan, Construction Traffic Method Statement, Arboricultural Impact Assessment]

conditions.summary: Finish and colour of structures and solar panel frames
conditions.text: Notwithstanding any details submitted, no development shall commence on site until full details of the finish and colour of all structures, equipment, fencing and support frames for the solar panels hereby approved have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and maintained thereafter for the lifetime of the development hereby approved.

conditions.summary: 40-year operational period and decommissioning
conditions.text: Within 1 month of the date of first export of electricity to either the National Grid or to the Wing Water Treatment Works ("the date of first export") confirmation shall be provided in writing to the Local Planning Authority of the same. The use of the land for the generation of electricity as hereby permitted shall cease on or before the expiry of a 40-year period from the date of first export. The land shall thereafter be restored to its former condition in accordance with a scheme of decommissioning work ("Decommissioning Method Statement"). The Decommissioning Method Statement, including the dismantling and removal of all elements (with the exception of the Substation and associated access), shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval not later than 39 years and 6 months from the date of first export of electricity, or within 3 months of the cessation of electricity generation at the site, whichever is earlier. The approved scheme shall be carried out and completed within 6 months from the date that the planning permission hereby granted expires.

conditions.summary: Tree and hedgerow protection during construction and decommissioning
conditions.text: Before any works commence on site other than site preparation works, the trees and hedgerows shown for retention on Plan BHA_4736_02 shall be protected as required in accordance with BS5837 and that plan and shall remain so protected until all construction on site is complete. The trees shall be protected during the decommissioning of the site in the same manner or in accordance with any standard that subsequently supersedes BS5837.

conditions.summary: Landscaping implementation and maintenance of plantings
conditions.text: All changes in hard landscaping, planting, seeding or turfing shown on the approved landscaping details shall be carried out during the first planting and seeding season (October - March inclusive) following the commencement of the development or in such other phased arrangement as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Any trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years of being planted die are removed or seriously damaged or seriously diseased shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size and species.

conditions.summary: Noise impact assessment in accordance with BS 4142:2014+A1(2019)
conditions.text: A noise impact assessment shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The assessment shall be undertaken in accordance with BS 4142:2014+A1(2019) prior to commencement, taking into account both day and night-time noise levels, and will be used to inform any necessary noise mitigation scheme for the proposed development. Thereafter the development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details, including any necessary mitigation, prior to first use, and shall thereafter be retained and maintained as such in perpetuity.

conditions.summary: Contaminated land investigation and remediation scheme
conditions.text: No development other than that required to be carried out as part of an approved scheme of remediation shall commence until sections (i) to (iii) of this condition, below, have been complied with. [Detailed contamination assessment, remediation scheme submission, implementation procedures, and unexpected contamination reporting requirements specified across multiple subsections (i)-(iv)]

conditions.summary: Soil Management Plan for construction, operation and decommissioning
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of each phase of development (Construction, Operation and Decommissioning), a Soil Management Plan shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The plan shall include, but not be limited to details pertaining to careful soil management during each phase, including consideration of the appropriate time of year for soil handling, planting beneath the panels and returning the land to the former land quality as indicated in Appendix 6 of the Agricultural Land Classification survey dated 3rd March 2023 - Issue 4 carried out by Amet Property. The Management Plan shall adhere to the guidance set out in the following documents (or any subsequent replacement versions): Defra's Construction Code of Practice for the Sustainable Use of Soils on Construction Sites (September 2009); and The British Society of Soil Science Working with Soil Guidance Note on Benefiting from Soil Management in Development and Construction.

conditions.summary: Access on Morcott Road to be fully implemented
conditions.text: Prior to the installation of the solar panel infrastructure for each phase the related access on Morcott Road shall be fully implemented in accordance with the details shown on the Proposed Access Arrangements plan ref P22-1447-Figure 3.1.

conditions.summary: Internal access roads, parking and turning facilities
conditions.text: Prior to commissioning the solar farm infrastructure, the facilities for internal access roads, parking and turning shall be fully implemented, with full details to be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing prior to commencement. Following any wholesale solar panel replacement scheme, any damaged areas or routes will be fully remediated.

conditions.summary: Vehicle-to-vehicle visibility splays at site access
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of development vehicle to vehicle visibility splays will be provided in accordance with the details shown on the Proposed Access Arrangements plan, ref P22-1447-Figure 3.1, with no obstruction above 600mm above ground level and thereafter maintained until the completion of decommissioning the site.

conditions.summary: Construction traffic routing via approved green route
conditions.text: All construction vehicles associated with the solar panel areas and access via Morcott Road will use the green construction route only as shown on the Construction Traffic Routing Plan, ref P22-1447 Figure 4.1, which applies to the construction, any wholesale replacement scheme and decommissioning.

conditions.summary: Construction Management Plan with noise, dust, wheel cleaning and site management
conditions.text: No development shall take place until a Construction Management Plan has been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, which will include the following:- a) A scheme for monitoring, reporting and control of construction noise and vibration including hours of working and scope for remedial action b) A scheme for the control of dust and scope for remedial action in the event that dust is identified as an issue or any complaints are received c) A scheme of chassis and wheel cleaning for all construction vehicles to include the details of locations and specifications of fully working jetted drive-thru bath type wheel wash systems together with hard surfacing laid between the apparatus and public highway in either concrete or tarmacadam, to be maintained free of mud, slurry and any other form of contamination during the period of construction with all exiting vehicles passing through. A contingency plan including, if necessary, the temporary cessation of all construction operations and movements to be implemented and any affected public highway thoroughly cleaned immediately with mechanical sweepers in the event that the approved vehicle cleaning scheme fails to be effective for any reason d) Measures to ensure that vehicles can access the site immediately upon arrival to ensure there is no parking, waiting, loading/unloading or queuing on the public highway with gates setback to an appropriate distance from the public highway e) Details of site compounds, storage area and contractor/visitor parking/turning f) Details of the site enclosure or part thereof and gated site security g) Confirmation of any tree protection measures h) Details of site notice with contact details and a scheme for dealing with complaints i) Details of any temporary lighting which must not directly light the public highway j) Phasing plans where necessary k) A scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from the construction works l) The erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Management Plan for the duration of the construction period, any wholesale replacement period and the decommissioning period.

conditions.summary: Temporary facilities for construction vehicle parking and turning
conditions.text: Temporary facilities for the internal access roads, parking, turning, loading and unloading of all vehicles visiting the site during the construction period shall be provided prior to installation of any solar panel infrastructure, prior to any wholesale solar panel replacement scheme and prior to the decommissioning period, in accordance with the details approved as part of the Construction Management Plan.

conditions.summary: Private temporary or permanent lighting – no danger to highway users
conditions.text: Any private temporary or permanent lighting shall be arranged so that no danger or inconvenience is caused to users of the public highway.

conditions.summary: Photographic surveys of highways before and after construction
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of any work on the site, a photographic survey will be carried out of The Cock Pit, Back Lane (between The Cock Pit and Wing Road), Wing Road (between Back Lane and Morcott Road), and Morcott Road (between Wing Road and 50m north of Pinfold Lane) and submitted to the Local Planning Authority. A replica photographic survey will be carried out within one month of the completion of construction to identify any damage to the highway resulting from traffic movements associated with the development and submitted to the Local Planning Authority. Any identified damage will need to be remediated by the applicant within three months of the date of that survey. The pre-construction and post construction surveys will also be required for any wholesale solar panel replacement scheme and for the decommissioning stage.

conditions.summary: Biodiversity Enhancement, Net Gain Assessment and Landscape Management
conditions.text: The development shall be undertaken in accordance with the Biodiversity Enhancement and Management Plan (prepared by Avian Ecology, dated May 2024) the updated Appendix 2 section 7, submitted to the Local Planning Authority on 11th July 2024, the Biodiversity Net Gain Assessment (prepared by Avian Ecology, dated 1st May 2024) and Landscape and Ecological Management Plan (prepared by Pegasus Group, dated 1st February 2024).

conditions.summary: Construction Method Statement for surface water drainage
conditions.text: No development shall take place until a Construction Method Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority which shall detail measures for the control of surface water drainage during the construction stage of the proposed development. It shall include details for the methodology and measures to be put in place to ensure no flooding from the site and how those measures will be managed. The approved Construction Method Statement shall thereafter be strictly adhered to throughout the construction period.

conditions.summary: Secondary Construction Method Statement for surface water during panel replacement
conditions.text: No wholesale replacement shall take place until a Secondary Construction Method Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority which shall detail measures for the control of surface water drainage during the construction stage of the proposed development. It shall include details for the methodology and measures to be put in place to ensure no flooding from the site and how those measures will be managed. The approved Secondary Construction Method Statement shall thereafter be strictly adhered to throughout the wholesale replacement period.

conditions.summary: Decommissioning Method Statement for surface water drainage
conditions.text: No decommissioning shall take place until a Decommissioning Method Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority which shall detail measures for the control of surface water drainage during the decommissioning stage of the proposed development. It shall include details for all phases, the methodology and measures to be put in place to ensure no flooding from the site and how those measures will be managed. The approved Decommissioning Method Statement shall thereafter be strictly adhered to throughout the decommissioning period.

conditions.summary: Construction hours limited to 08:00-20:00 weekdays and 08:00-13:00 Saturdays
conditions.text: Construction times (including deliveries) shall be limited to the following hours: 08:00 - 20:00 Monday to Friday; and 08:00 - 13:00 Saturdays. No construction works shall take place at any time on Sunday or a Bank Holidays No works nor delivers shall take place outside of these time without the prior written agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Cable route tree root protection details and approval
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the details approved as set out in condition 2 of this decision, prior to commencement of the works comprising the cable route from the solar site to the Oakham substation, detailed plans shall be provided to the Local Planning Authority for its written approval of any section of the route not proposed to be within the confines of the public highway carriageway. These plans shall identify the root protection areas of any trees impacted on by the proposed cable route, alongside details of how the connection is to be made without resulting in damage to tree roots in those areas. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

applications.address: Tinwell Lodge Business Park Steadfold Lane Tinwell Rutland
applications.description: Demolish existing Unit 9 which is currently classified as a grain store and replace with a new light industrial unit for warehouse storage facilities and office space. New bin store and bike store, fan house refurbishment.

conditions.summary: Development must begin within three years
conditions.text: The development shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with submitted plans
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans, labelled; Location Plan, drawing no. AL0101 P04 (received 02/04/2025); Block Plan as Proposed, drawing no. AL0203 P05 (received 02/04/2025); Site Plan as Proposed, drawing no. AL0212 P06 (received 02/04/2025); Site Plan showing BNG area, drawing no. AL0213 P01 (received 02/04/2025); Floor Plans and Roof Plan as Proposed, drawing no. AB0204 P01; Elevations as Proposed, drawing no. AB0804 P01; Floor Plans and Section as Proposed Commercial 1100L Bin Store with Doors, drawing no. AB0274 P01; Elevations as Proposed Commercial 1100L Bin Store with Doors, drawing no. AB0874 P01; Floor Plans and Section as Proposed Cycle Shelter, drawing no. AB0275 P01; Elevations as Proposed Cycle Shelter, drawing no. AB0875 P01; Elevations as Proposed Fan House Refurbishment, drawing no. AB0894 P02

conditions.summary: Use limited to B8 storage and E office use classes
conditions.text: The premises shall be used for the storage (use class B8) and offices (use class E), and for no other purpose including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any Statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

conditions.summary: HGV manoeuvring area provision and retention
conditions.text: Prior to occupation of the building the area identified for the purpose of HGVs manoeuvring as shown on plan AL0212 Rev P02 shall be provided and retained at all times for that sole purpose.

conditions.summary: Car and cycle parking provision and retention
conditions.text: The development shall not be occupied until such time as the car and cycle parking areas as shown on plan AL0212 Rev P02, have been provided and shall thereafter be retained for these purposes only at all times.

conditions.summary: Construction Management Plan required
conditions.text: No development shall take place, including any demolition work, until a Construction Management Plan has been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, which will include the following:- a. A scheme for monitoring, reporting and control of construction noise and vibration including hours of working and scope for remedial action. b. A scheme for the control of dust and scope for remedial action in the event that dust is identified as an issue or any complaints are received. c. Haul routes to the site from the strategic road network and hours of delivery d. Measures to ensure that vehicles can access the site immediately upon arrival to ensure there is no park, waiting, loading/unloading or queuing on the public highway. e. Details of site compounds, storage area and contractor/visitor parking/turning. f. Details of the site enclosure or part thereof and gated site security. g. Confirmation that any demolition will be carried out in accordance with the ecological assessment. h. Details of site notice with contact details and a scheme for dealing with complaints. i. Details of any temporary lighting which must not directly light the public highway. j. A scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from the demolition and construction works. k. The erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Management Plan.

conditions.summary: 30-year Habitat Monitoring and Management Plan (HMMP)
conditions.text: The development shall not commence until a 30 year Habitat Monitoring and Management Plan (HMMP), prepared in accordance with an approved Biodiversity Gain Plan, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The approved HMMP shall be strictly adhered to and implemented in full for its duration and shall contain the following: a) Description and evaluation of the features to be managed; b) Ecological trends and constraints on site that may influence management; c) Aims, objectives and targets for management - links with local and national species and habitat action plans; d) Description of the management operations necessary to achieving aims and objectives; e) Preparation of a works schedule, including annual works schedule; f) Details and a timetable of the monitoring needed to measure the effectiveness of management; g) Details of the persons responsible for the implementation and monitoring; h) Mechanisms of adaptive management to account for necessary changes in work schedule to achieve the required targets; and i) Details of methodology and frequency of monitoring reports to be submitted to the Local Planning Authority to assess biodiversity gain

conditions.summary: Public Right of Way (PROW) Operational Safety Plan

conditions.summary: Electricity export notification and 40-year operational limit with decommissioning
conditions.text: Within 1 month of the date of first export of electricity to either the National Grid or to the Wing Water Treatment Works ('the date of first export') confirmation shall be provided in writing to the Local Planning Authority of the same. The use of the land for the generation of electricity as hereby permitted shall cease on or before the expiry of a 40-year period from the date of first export. The land shall thereafter be restored to its former condition in accordance with a scheme of decommissioning work ('Decommissioning Method Statement'). The Decommissioning Method Statement, including the dismantling and removal of all elements (with the exception of the Substation and associated access), shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval not later than 39 years and 6 months from the date of first export of electricity, or within 3 months of the cessation of electricity generation at the site, whichever is earlier.

conditions.summary: Tree and hedgerow protection during construction and decommissioning

The trees shall be protected during the decommissioning of the site in the same manner or in accordance with any standard that subsequently supersedes BS5837.

conditions.summary: Hard landscaping and planting implementation and maintenance
conditions.text: All changes in hard landscaping, planting, seeding or turfing shown on the approved landscaping details shall be carried out during the first planting and seeding season (October - March inclusive) following the commencement of the development or in such other phased arrangement as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Any trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years of being planted die are removed or seriously damaged or seriously diseased shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size and species.

conditions.summary: Noise impact assessment implementation and maintenance

conditions.summary: Contaminated land investigation and remediation

In the event that contamination is found at any time when carrying out the approved development that was not previously identified it shall be reported in writing within 5 days to the Local Planning Authority and once the Local Planning Authority has identified the part of the site affected by the unexpected contamination development must be halted on that part of the site.

conditions.summary: Soil Management Plan for construction, operations and decommissioning

Part b - decommissioning: Prior to the decommissioning of the development, a Soil Management Plan shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The plan shall include, but not be limited to details pertaining to careful soil management during each phase, including consideration of the appropriate time of year for soil handling, planting beneath the panels and returning the land to the former land quality as indicated in Appendix 6 of the Agricultural Land Classification survey.

The visibility splays shall be thereafter maintained until the completion of decommissioning the site.

No wholesale replacement of solar panels or decommissioning works shall take place at the site until details of the proposed access route for those works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such details shall be submitted not less than three months prior to the commencement of the relevant wholesale replacement or decommissioning works.

conditions.summary: Construction Management Plan compliance
conditions.text: The development hereby approved, shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Construction Management Plan Revision E dated July 2026.

conditions.text: Any private temporary or permanent lighting shall be arranged so that no danger or inconvenience is caused to users of the public highway.

It shall include details for all phases, the methodology and measures to be put in place to ensure no flooding from the site and how those measures will be managed.

No works nor deliveries shall take place outside of these times without the prior written agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Compliance with approved plans

conditions.summary: Time limit for commencement (three years)
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: External materials approval
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be completed in accordance with the external materials specified within drawing number 7744-08-430 REV 6 as approved or any alternatives to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Hard and soft landscaping standards
conditions.text: All hard and soft landscaping shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details as set out in drawing numbers 08-420 rev 6 and TRP1 rev 2 to a reasonable standard in accordance with the relevant British Standards or other recognised Codes of Good Practice.

conditions.summary: Timing of planting and seeding
conditions.text: All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.

conditions.summary: Protection of retained trees (five years)
conditions.text: No tree shown retained on the approved plans shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped within five years of the completion of development without the written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Replacement of lost retained trees
conditions.text: If any retained tree referred to in condition 6 is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies within 5 years of the completion of development, a replacement tree should be planted in the same place and that tree shall be of such a size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Tree protection fencing (BS5837:2012)
conditions.text: Before any development commences, including any site clearance or demolition works, any trees on the site to be retained shall be protected by fencing or other means of enclosure in accordance with BS5837:2012.

conditions.summary: Bird nesting season clearance restrictions
conditions.text: All areas of hedges, scrub or similar vegetation where birds may nest which are to be removed as part of the development, are to be cleared outside the bird-nesting season (March - August inclusive) or if clearance during the bird nesting season cannot be reasonably be avoided, a suitably qualified ecologist will check the areas to be removed immediately prior to clearance and advise whether nesting birds are present. If active nests are recorded, no vegetation clearance or other works that may disturb active nests shall proceed until all young have fledged the nest.

conditions.summary: Habitat management and ecological enhancements (BNG Plan)
conditions.text: The recommended habitat management and ecological enhancements set out within the Ecological Assessment and Biodiversity Net Gain Plan by EPR dated August 2023 ref. 22/86-3B shall be implemented and permanently maintained in accordance with the approved details.
